definitions.full: H4357. miklah II. [ מִכְלָה ] noun [feminine] completeness, perfection ; — only plural construct intensive זָהָב מִכְלוֺת 2Chr 4:21 perfections of gold = purest gold. — I. מִכְלָה see below כלא .
